retained_noncertified_trials: Exact_Audit.json retains seven attempted target pairs whose nuisance coordinates were held at independent arithmetic values. Only the correct target pair passed this restricted construction; this did not establish infeasibility. The later MILP search found two strict feasible models after nuisance coordinates were allowed to vary.
precision_method: Exact dyadic midpoint/radius serialization is used for critical intervals. Independent replay rounds outward to 2^-192 and uses integer arithmetic.
solver_scope: HiGHS results propose rational multipliers or integer vectors. Strict interval or integer checks decide every published bound, exclusion and feasible witness.
noise_scope: The added-radius test widens already certified root enclosures, preserving cutoff membership. It uses a conservative global derivative bound and recomputes the zero moment with enlarged intervals; it does not model zeros of a perturbed field.
